message:
Free/Pro
We will sponsor your upgrade to Business+

Business+
- **You push it**, Instructions: one-time setup first: Admin in sidebar → Workspace settings → Security → Import & export data → Export tab → submit an application link → request the "All channels and conversations" export type (needs Primary Owner sign-off; Slack support reviews it within a couple of business days). Once approved: same page → Export tab → choose All channels and conversations → pick date range → Start Export, and a .zip of JSON (now including private channels and DMs) lands via emailed link, still file links only, no file bodies.

As above, if you don't have a Business+ subscription, let us know ASAP and we will sponsor you.
notes: The All channels and conversations export requires Business+ or Enterprise, Primary Owner sign-off, and Slack support approval.
Exports contain attachment file links only, not file bodies.
